attempts.text:
**The window opens on the anchor and a short spine.** Column 0, `rcnB`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 1% of calls. The model names 97% of them, 0.33 bits.

**A variable column follows at 1**, `rcnA`, carried by 88%. Then columns 11 to 17, `gatY` to `gatR`, are [[galactitol transport and tagatose bisphosphate]]. Through columns 36 to 46 a branch of 11 shell families runs in 10 to 11%, [[phage capsid and lysis]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 90% against 78%, and hesitates less there, 0.43 against 0.66 bits. It hesitates most at column 66, `rfbC`, a variable column, 1.42 bits.

**The last column is `hisF`**, in 50% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 81% of genes**, 0.61 bits on average, perplexity 2.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.94 against 0.29 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 91%.

label: rcnB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the rcnB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rcnB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,603 to 1,682 from dnaA. Read in 531 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rcnB once); 42,480 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 81% of genes, 0.61 bits on average (perplexity 2.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 19,906 calls, named 93%, 0.26 bits; shell 19,137 calls, named 80%, 0.62 bits; cloud 3,437 calls, named 14%, 2.57 bits. Outside an RGP 21,446 calls, named 91%, 0.29 bits; inside an RGP 21,034 calls, named 71%, 0.94 bits. Columns: 17 spine, 36 fork, 27 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.94 against 0.29 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 91%); 21,034 of the 42,480 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 66 (rfbC, a variable column) 1.42 bits, RGP 78%; column 67 (lpxT, a variable column) 1.38 bits, RGP 76%; column 65 (wbdC, a variable column) 1.36 bits, RGP 81%. The 39 columns (columns 11-17 and 41-72) where most calls are in an RGP: named 76%, 0.72 bits on average; the other 41 columns: named 85%, 0.50 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 17 spine columns: named 90%, 0.43 bits on average; the 63 fork and variable columns: named 78%, 0.66 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 66, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 11-17 (fork), RGP 70-92%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 1%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
